dedupe_keys.name: municipal co operative seed cleaning in alberta

description: The source reports municipal cooperative seed-cleaning operations over ten-year windows. Measures include total seed bushels, dockage removal, total cleaning, average throughput per plant and treated-seed cleaning. Two XLSX descriptors cover 2004–2005 through 2013–2014 and 2005–2006 through 2014–2015. These are observations of food-supply processing facilities and their throughput. They are not field-level crop-yield or biological growth observations. Plant locations, equipment capacity, individual facility identifiers and processing-resource requirements are not established by the metadata. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual payload access and costs remain unverified. No linked dataset, workbook, document, legal text, model or code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond those explicitly described are not established.
